review_notes: I read the whole file. It defines the structure `Filter.IsApproximateUnit` and a few lemmas about it. I searched Mathlib for "ApproximateUnit", "approximate unit" and "approximate identity". The only other hits were downstream users: `Mathlib/Analysis/CStarAlgebra/ApproximateUnit.lean` (which defines `IsIncreasingApproximateUnit` on top of this structure) and `Mathlib/Analysis/CStarAlgebra/PositiveLinearFunctional.lean`. I found no independent Mathlib definition of approximate units. The structure bundles two `Tendsto` conditions with `NeBot`, which no existing predicate does. The two lemmas `iff_neBot_and_le_nhds_one` and `iff_le_nhds_one` overlap, but that is a theorem-level overlap and outside this rubric. I found nothing to report.
